results.content:
## Who should use Drama 3, and who should skip it?

Use it for audiobooks, fiction podcasts, game dialogue and short video where each line is rendered, reviewed and kept. The scoped tags are the feature that earns the upgrade: fixing one word in a line is cheaper than regenerating a chapter, which Fish Audio's CEO Rissa Cao frames as the point of long-form work. If you script videos or podcasts, AI podcast script generators and AI video script tools pair naturally with it.

Look at the alternatives if you want the most proven voice in blind listening, in which case ElevenLabs and Cartesia are the obvious comparisons, or a Hume AI style emotion layer. My ElevenLabs alternatives post lines them up. [...] 1. Web app and mobile apps. Open Text to Speech on fish.audio with `?version=drama-3`, or use the iOS and Android apps. The landing page offers Drama 3 free to try, and Uncle Roger's licensed voice is available for roasts.
2. API. Keep your `POST /v1/tts` request and add the header `model: drama-3`. Fish Audio's launch thread lists launch-day partners including ComfyUI, Runway, Pika, OpenRouter and Vercel, though I only checked ComfyUI's announcement, which says it runs as a Partner Node. If you already use Runway, check whether its node exposes the same direction syntax.
3. Open weights. The model is on Hugging Face, with SGLang-Omni serving from day zero. [...] On list price, Drama 3 is cheaper than Eleven v4 but dearer than Turbo, so the choice is about the voice rather than the bill. For deeper breakdowns see my Eleven v4 pricing and ElevenLabs pricing guides, and Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS pricing if you are weighing Google.

The apps work differently. Drama 3 costs the same credits as S2.1 Pro, and until 12 November a new Plus, Pro or Max plan is 50% off for the first month on monthly billing or the first year on annual.

results.title: Fish Audio Launches Drama 3: Direct AI Voices in Plain Language, Control Every Word and Shift Emotion Mid-Sentence
results.content:
Drama 3 caps a nonstop run of launches for Fish Audio, which marked its first anniversary this summer. In the past few months alone, the team has shipped aspeech-to-text model with built-in speaker diarization and state-of-the-art word error rate;Fish Creative, a single workspace for professional content creators; and mobile apps foriOS andAndroid. Drama 3's predecessor, S2.1 Pro, became the most-requested speech model on OpenRouter within three weeks of launch. [...] Fish Audio ranked No. 1 onAhrefs' list of the 50 fastest-growing AI companies with brand search up 740% year over year. The company has grown from zero to $21 million in annual recurring revenue and now serves more than 15 million users, from individual creators to developers and enterprises. That growth compounds across channels, as Fish Audio's open-source community, influencer content, and search feed one another. It also reflects how the company operates: research, product, and go-to-market work together instead of in isolation.

Drama 3 is available today at fish.audio. For the first 30 days, API usage is 80% off, and enterprises switching from another voice provider get their first three months free. Pricing details are at fish.audio/plan.

About Fish Audio [...] Fish Audio Logo

Fish Audio Logo

 

Built to give developers, studios, and creators unprecedented control over voice performance, Drama 3 is designed for a wide range of applications, including audio dramas and interactive media, audiobooks and multilingual dubbing, games and animation, AI companion experiences, and content creation platforms. A drama studio can direct a two-character argument as a single scene, an audiobook narrator can shift from calm to trembling mid-sentence, and a game team can fix even a single word of dialogue without re-rendering the clip. Simply put, the model turns voice AI from something teams generate into something they can easily direct and edit.
